name: an attachment on the move satisfies require-evidence
notes: The wf_rules "Guarded" definition is the advisory tier's deliberately-warned example: its any-state → "Done" edge carries no rules, so adviseWorkflowDef reports rule-bypassable on this def and publish accepts it anyway (coordination doc §8, requirement 4). The wildcard is left uncovered on purpose — an empty wildcard beside the guarded "Doing" → "Done" edge is what makes these fixtures depend on exact-over-wildcard precedence, and a covering guard would retire that witness while leaving every one of them green.
